title: Restrict expense configuration maintenance to admins
summary: Restrict configuration maintenance for expense management to administrators by removing write permissions from the Expense Mgmt. Edit permission set and granting them only through Expense Mgmt. Admin.
key_points: Remove insert, modify, and delete permissions for Expense User, Expense Team, and Expense Approval Setup from Expense Mgmt. Edit
Grant configuration permissions exclusively through Expense Mgmt. Admin permission set
Prevent standard users (D365 BASIC, D365 TEAM MEMBER) from modifying expense setup while preserving their ability to edit expense reports
Employee synchronization continues using scoped inherent permissions
Add test coverage for the permission separation
quote: Remove direct insert, modify, and delete permissions for Expense User, Expense Team, and Expense Approval Setup from Expense Mgmt. Edit.
